phaseProfile.interpretation: Monotonic wall intervals. Nested phases and parallel workers overlap. Aggregate sums are neither CPU time nor additive workflow duration. Bytes identify each interval's public processed-byte basis and can count the same bytes in several phases. Timeline retains its first bounded entries; aggregates include later completed intervals.

nativeScheduling.note: Submission-to-callback includes handle allocation, submission and observer locking. Callback intervals overlap; their sums are not operation walltime or CPU time. Join includes useful callback work. No executor callbacks is possible for an inline single-worker native path.

cpuReservations.interpretation: Acquisition intervals include allocator/topology work; parallel intervals overlap. Peak reservations include other concurrently active in-process leases. No CPU-time or starvation guarantee is inferred from these aggregates.

interpretation: Native AOT GUI diagnostic observations, not an overall release verdict. Fixture preparation and human entropy collection precede operation timing. Work wall excludes measured application dialogs but may include unmeasured file-picker/user waits; overlapping phase/queue/join sums are not CPU or end-to-end walltime. Fault cases use public canonical records and simulated adapter failures, not evidence of human mouse capture or an actual Apple RNG/mlock hardware failure. Source bytes and compressed/cipher phase bytes are distinct throughput bases.
